Note: NOT AN INDEPENDENT MEASUREMENT. Figure 5 is DERIVED from Figures 3 and 4 of the same paper: its caption reads 'Mean number of synapses per neuron, derived from data of the present study, as a function of age', and p. 202 states 'Using data concerning packing density of neurons together with data on synaptic density, it is possible to calculate an approximate mean number of synapses/neuron in layer 3 of middle frontal gyrus (Fig. 5)'. The build verifies the arithmetic: multiplying each triangle by the neuronal density plotted at the same abscissa in Fig. 4 reproduces a value plotted in Fig. 3 to a mean of 0.24 and a maximum of 1.01 x 10^8 synapses/mm3 (the maximum is the 'Aged (74-90)' column, where Fig. 5 plots one mean but Fig. 3 plots four separate brains). DO NOT TREAT THIS ITEM AS EVIDENCE INDEPENDENT OF Huttenlocher__1979_Figure3 AND Huttenlocher__1979_Figure4: using all three together double-counts the same measurements. Digitisation: the markers of this figure were pixel-digitised from the embedded page bitmap (1950 x 3000 px, 8-bit grey) by Huttenlocher__1979_Figures3-6_extract.py (conda env 'python'; pymupdf, numpy, scipy), run 2026-10-31; a second run reports 'snapshot unchanged'. Open markers are located as the white region each outline encloses; filled markers by eroding the dark mask with a disk, which removes the fitted curve and the error bars. ESTIMATED ERROR +/- 0.05 x 10^4 synapses/neuron. POINTS CONTAINED vs RESOLVED: the figure contains 10 plotted points and all 10 were individually resolved; none was inferred. The paper prints no count; the 10 triangles correspond one for one to the 10 open circles of Fig. 4.
